data.name: Stratoscape
data.short_description: Stratoscape is a challenging and addictive stationary wave shooter exclusively for VR. Beat your high score as you blast waves of robots and creatures in this solo adventure campaign. Teleport through 8 unique levels, and enjoy some sick techno music on your journey!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 (AMD FX 8350) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or greater
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 (AMD FX 8350) or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480 or greater
